question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**improve**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• The passage discusses the condition and management of forest fires.
 
• The appropriate verb should indicate something that positively affects the condition of the forests.
 
• "**Improve**" fits well as it denotes making the situation better, which aligns with the context of managing forest fires effectively.
 
• Other options ("**deteriorate**", "**ruin**", "**control**") do not fit the context of describing the positive outcome of forest fire management.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** Additional Information__ ** 

 
• Deteriorate (बिगड़ना): "Deteriorate" means to become progressively worse, which does not fit the context of improving forest conditions.
 
• Ruin (बर्बाद करना): "Ruin" means to destroy or severely damage, which does not reflect the idea of improving the situation.
 
• Control (नियंत्रण): "Control" means to manage or regulate, which does not align with the idea of making the situation better.
